groups.title: Star Battles is live
entries: 10 v 10 Conquest around Saturn: capture three relay stations or out-gun the enemy fleet, with AI wingmen filling every empty seat.
Three starfighters with gimbal-mounted cannons, lasers, railguns and lock-on missiles, plus animated engines with boost trails.
Destructible asteroid field: shoot big rocks and they split into hot, tumbling fragments.
Online multiplayer over Wi-Fi or the internet, with a public battle list, plus pilot accounts and cloud saves.
Console-style home screen, full touch, gamepad and keyboard controls, and an in-game updater that shows what's new.
